verdict.rationale: Foreloop ships an official, globally installable CLI. The docs say it can be driven "from anything that can run one, including coding agents and cron", and `--json` works on every command with a stable, additive-only output shape. API keys and a streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint cover non-interactive auth and access, which supports unattended and scheduled automation. Missing for 10: an explicit CI-pipeline integration guide or example (e.g. GitHub Actions), documented non-interactive auth for the CLI (env-var or key flag), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Projects, loops, intentions, stories and tasks from a terminal — and from anything that can run one, including coding agents and cron.
`--json` works on any command and has a stable shape. Additive changes only.
npm i -g foreloop   # installs globally, so the CLI works in any directory
An MCP client needs that URL and an API key and nothing else.
